_doc: Our own props in this zone (OwnProps.cs; the presets: tools/assets/env_props.json, built by env_props.py). pieces: a kit piece of props.json -> the preset standing in for it wherever it stands (fitted to the kit piece's height, on its footprint). keep: [x, z] places where the kit piece stays (another lead's). place: a preset stood at x, z (on the ground, + y), turned rot radians about up, scaled; or along a line from a to b ([x, y, z], the preset's long axis on it) at radius r (a log). bare: [r, k] the grass gone within r and thinning out to k times r (with the fires, the first four in the zone). hide: [x, z, r, max height] the web game's blocked-out meshes there go (not its kit pieces). lamps: a lamp holder's light by its glow node: color, energy (times the road lamps'), range, att. nudge: [x, z, dx, dz, degrees] the preset standing in for the kit piece at x, z shifted and turned (the chest off the log's end).
